Nothing there. `https://example.com/test-page` doesn't exist — it returns **HTTP 404** (Cloudflare, cached), and the body served is the IANA reserved-domain placeholder, byte-for-byte identical to `https://example.com/`:

> **Example Domain** — "This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations."

So the page has no real content: no article, no "Test Page for Zo Co-browse" text, nothing about the extension. The title you see in the tab is coming from the local test harness, not from that URL — `example.com` is the standard dummy domain used for exactly this kind of fixture, and no path on it serves anything but the same 559-byte placeholder.

For your Zo Co-browse work this is actually a useful signal: the page-context fetch reached the URL and came back with a definitive status, so the pipeline isn't silently failing — the target was simply a placeholder, not a live page. Point a test at a real URL and it should capture content normally.

[^1]: https://example.com/test-page
